without Stripe, checkout answers 503 and the webhook 404

signup retries an incomplete profile before creating an account, and does not block an existing login
streamed OpenRouter actual cost reaches the credit ledger instead of the catalog estimate
a run on a tenant with too little credit stops before any call, as a spend limit; a small balance caps the call's max_tokens

the API: a person's lowBalance, and the end users under their threshold
